components.name: HeaderNav
components.purpose: Top navigation with app title 'ATS CV Hazırlayıcı', sample dataset loader ('Örnek Veri Yükle'), clear form button ('Temizle'), and primary 'PDF İndir' CTA.

components.name: AtsScoreChecker
components.purpose: Real-time ATS quality audit widget checking contact completeness, date formatting, bullet counts, single-column rule compliance, and key sections.

components.name: CvFormEditor
components.purpose: Left pane accordion/tabbed editor container for all CV sections.

components.name: PersonalDetailsForm
components.purpose: Ad, Soyad, Unvan, E-posta, Telefon, Konum (İl/İlçe), LinkedIn, GitHub, Web Sitesi.

components.name: ProfileSummaryForm
components.purpose: Profesyonel Özet / Profil metin alanı (AI/ATS önerili ipuçları ile).

components.name: WorkExperienceForm
components.purpose: İş deneyimi ekle/çıkar listesi: Şirket, Pozisyon, Şehir, Başlangıç Tarihi, Bitiş Tarihi, Halen Çalışıyorum seçeneği, Sorumluluklar/Başarılar (maddeler).

components.name: EducationForm
components.purpose: Eğitim bilgisi ekle/çıkar listesi: Okul/Üniversite, Bölüm/Derece, Şehir, Başlangıç Tarihi, Mezuniyet Tarihi, Not Ortalaması (isteğe bağlı).

components.name: SkillsForm
components.purpose: Teknik ve Sosyal Beceriler düzenleme (Virgülle ayrılmış veya etiket bazlı ekleme).

components.name: ProjectsForm
components.purpose: Projeler ekle/çıkar: Proje Adı, Rol, Başlangıç/Bitiş Tarihi, Proje Linki, Açıklama maddeleri.

components.name: CertificatesForm
components.purpose: Sertifikalar ekle/çıkar: Sertifika Adı, Kurum, Alınma Tarihi, Geçerlilik Tarihi, Sertifika No/Link.

components.name: LanguagesForm
components.purpose: Diller ekle/çıkar: Dil, Seviye (Ana Dil, İleri, Orta, Başlangıç).

components.name: CvPreviewPaper
components.purpose: The single-column ATS document preview matching pure text parsing rules.

components.name: PdfDownloadManager
components.purpose: Handles instant browser-side PDF generation using html2pdf.js / html2canvas + jspdf or clean window.print fallback.

instructions_to_main_agent: Language must be strictly TURKISH across the entire UI and default sample data.
The CV preview canvas MUST enforce a clean single-column structure with standard text element markup (h1, h2, h3, p, ul, li) and standard system fonts so ATS software can easily parse text.
Do NOT place contact details inside header/footer elements of the PDF export container; place them directly inside the top body flow of the main page.
Provide a pre-filled realistic Turkish sample CV (e.g., 'Ahmet Yılmaz - Kıdemli Yazılım Geliştirici') so the user immediately sees a populated preview on launch.
Include 'Örnek Veriyi Yükle' (Load Sample Data) and 'Formu Temizle' (Clear Form) controls in the top navigation bar or editor action bar.

Ensure all input fields for dates (Başlangıç Tarihi, Bitiş Tarihi / Alınma Tarihi) support clear month-year formats (e.g. 'Ocak 2022' or '2022-01') and 'Halen Devam Ediyor' checkboxes for ongoing roles/education.
Support collapsible accordion sections or tabbed steps on the left side to keep the builder clean and organized.

Add 'data-testid' attributes to all form inputs, section toggles, add/remove buttons, preview container, and PDF download button (e.g., data-testid='pdf-download-button', data-testid='input-first-name', data-testid='add-experience-button').
Provide a mobile tab toggle ('Düzenle' / 'Canlı Önizleme') on screens smaller than lg breakpoint so mobile users can easily switch between editing and viewing the paper.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. In frontend design, create distinct, high-polished frontends that surprise and delight.
Never use dark color gradients. Dark colors look good when used solid or with crisp 1px borders.
Create visual hierarchy with generous spacing (p-6, p-8), high contrast text, and clear borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always target specific properties like transition-colors or transition-transform.
You MUST NOT center align the app main text flow.
Every interaction needs micro-animations: subtle hover scale on buttons, smooth tab changes, clean accordion expand/collapse.

Never use generic AI emojis (🤖, 🧠, 💡) for standard UI icons. Use Lucide icons (e.g., Download, Plus, Trash2, CheckCircle2, FileText, Sparkles, User, Briefcase, GraduationCap, Award, Globe, Languages).
Ensure interactive components have explicit focus and hover text states with strong contrast ratios.
